$comment: The product's identity, in one place.
Change `name` here and run `npm run app:name` — it rewrites the Dart and
TypeScript constants, the Android string resource and the iOS plist. Nothing
else in the repo should ever contain the product name as a literal.
This exists because app-store names must be globally unique, so finding an
available one takes several attempts, and a rename that touches 66 files is
a rename nobody wants to try twice.
`bundleId` is NOT rewritten by that script. It is permanent once published —
both stores identify an app by it forever — so changing it is a deliberate
operation, not a side effect of picking a different display name. It is
recorded here so the two are visibly separate decisions.
`storeName` is the App Store / Play listing title, which must be unique
across the whole store and is often longer than the name under the icon.
It is set in each console by hand and lives here only as a record.
